pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-05.png with Read. It loaded. The page has 3 panels: a wide top panel, then a lower-left and a lower-right panel.
pages.observation: Natural order: Ananya 'Hello, Ravi. Tell me what brings you in.' (top right), then the large teal 'PATIENT DETAILS: current vitals · prior health info · allergy panel · AI mic on · patient docs · lab reports' (left), Ravi 'I've been feeling tired lately.', teal 'SOAP NOTES: fill in manually and choose ICD or SNOMED codes, or let AI listen and summarise the conversation', then caption 'Technology supports the workflow. The conversation stays human.' (ananya). Issues: (1) The move to the consulting room has no transition caption; Ananya and Ravi are suddenly together. (2) In the top panel the balloon is top right but the large label is on the left. A left-to-right reader may start with the label. The balloon's higher position probably wins, but it is uncertain. (3) Both teal labels are long, dense lists of features. 'AI mic on' and 'ICD or SNOMED' are jargon with no explanation, and it is unclear whose screen it is and whether both labels are on the same screen. (4) Ananya never answers 'I've been feeling tired lately' on this page. A caption follows instead, so the patient's complaint is left hanging; the reply comes only on page 06. (5) The caption's claim that 'the conversation stays human' conflicts with the SOAP label advertising that AI listens. The art must show this visually. No face is covered.
